saveError: Could not save the attendance configuration.
noConfigInfo: This institute has never configured attendance. The values below are sensible starting points — save them to make them real.
modeSectionDescription: How a day's attendance comes into existence. Everything else follows from this.
timeTrackingDescription: Employees check in and check out. Hours worked decide whether the day is full, half or absent, measured against their shift.
dayLevelDescription: No check in or out. An admin marks each person present, absent, half day or on leave from the daily board.
timezoneSectionDescription: Which day a check-in belongs to. Payroll buckets attendance by this zone, so a stamp at 00:30 lands on a different day — and a different month — depending on what is set here.
timezoneDescription: An IANA zone name, e.g. Asia/Dubai, Europe/London, America/New_York.
weekendSectionDescription: Days the institute is closed every week. These are marked WEEKEND automatically and never count as absent.
weekendDescription: A Sunday–Thursday institute picks Friday and Saturday here.
thresholdsSectionDescription: The minute counts that turn hours worked into a verdict on the day.
halfDayThresholdDescription: Below this, the day is absent rather than a half day.
overtimeThresholdDescription: Minutes beyond the shift before overtime starts accruing.
trackOvertimeDescription: Records hours past the threshold as overtime on the attendance record. Off means extra hours are simply not counted.
autoCheckoutSectionDescription: A safety net for people who forget to check out — without it their day never closes and the hours never resolve.
closeOpenDaysDescription: Any check-in still open at the time below is checked out at that time.
geoFenceSectionDescription: Restrict check-ins to a radius around the campus. Employees outside it can't record attendance.
restrictByLocationDescription: Needs location permission on the employee's device — a device that refuses it cannot check in.
ipRestrictionSectionDescription: Restrict check-ins to the institute's own network — the usual alternative to a geo-fence for a desk-based team.
restrictByNetworkDescription: Only the addresses below may record attendance. Leaving the list empty with this on blocks everyone.
allowedIpsDescription: One per line. Exact addresses or CIDR blocks — 198.51.100.0/24 covers the whole range.
dayLevelHiddenNote: Auto-checkout, geo-fence and IP restriction only constrain check-ins, so they are hidden in day-level mode. Any values already saved are kept — switch back to time tracking to see them.
needsAdminNote: Changing attendance configuration needs an HR Admin role in this institute.
